newsitem.title: USA: Carson Pirie March sales up.
newsitem.headline: Carson Pirie March sales up.

text.p: Carson Pirie Scott & Co said Thursday that same-store sales for the five weeks ended April 5 were up seven percent from a year earlier.
Total sales rose 12.2 percent, to $103.9 million from $92.6 milion, it said.
For the year to date period, same-store sales were up 7.4 percent and total sales rose 12.6 percent, to $172.8 million from $153.5 million.

Stanton Bluestone, chairman, said, "Our strongest categories were feminine sportswear, better men's collections, shoes and fine jewelry. March sales results were positively affected by a promotional shift which more than compensated for the Easter Sunday closure falling into the month of March in 1997."
Absent the impact of these two events, March comparable-store sales would have increased about five percent, he said.
Carson Pirie operates 53 department stores and four furniture stores.
